translation.name: Yaubada Yana Walo Yemidi Vauvauna
translation.englishName: ’Auhelawa: Yaubada Yana Walo Yemidi Vauvauna New Testament

content: Tauwasawasao adi venuwamwau
Omiu tauwasawasao, amdou ili'ilimani, wuwuna hauga vitaina mata vehabana amdou ta'eta'e.
Yami wasawasao bada hipwapwaha, na hinage ami ale'owone bada wesoweso hi'aidi'o.

Yami manewowa bi'ibi'idi mata hiwalo mahalavaegomiu, wuwuna nigele tomowa amyamohemohedi ainaena Yaubada yana hauga lauvetala ainai yami tobwatobwaone mata hi'abigwaipile ta dova aiwa ala'alahina taumiu alonai.
Na yami oya adi taupaihowao nigele amyayemaiha ili'ilimanidi. Eeta taupaihowaone yadi ulumiyai na yadi dou bada Yaubada Tauwahiwahiyala ibenalena'o.
Na yami miya bale'uwai inamwanamwa alili wuwuna hauga maudoina mayami yaliyaya, na ami sinibu mwala'idi oiyemwalowoi ilowoinanegomiu, dova ta'i guyau maheyadi.
Wuwuna hiya dumwadumwaludi amhinahinabodaidi'o yo amyemwalowoidi'o, ta nigele howahowana na alimiyai hiyemaiha.
Alama'i'ita vehabana

Tahiguwao, am'alama'i'ita ana higa yada Bada iwuyoma dova tanovi ana taupaihowa mayana alama'i'ita na iha'waha'wa 'wesu yo yaigalugalu na bolimai adi hauga ainai ta ana higa laulau'eli ana hauga ainai.
Ainaena omiu hinage am'alama'i'ita mayami atepatu wuwuna mata yada Badane ilau gwaipileuyoma.
Na tahiguwao, havena ambom am'ulu'ulumiyanegomiu, wuwuna mata yada Badane ilauvetalaegomiu, ta muhamuhana na imahalava.

Ainaena tahiguwao, amnuwatuwu avivini tauwalo mahalavao, hiya yada Bada vehabana hiwalowalo mahalava. Teina aba'ita namwanamwana alimiyai, wuwuna tauwalo mahalavao yadi miya vitai aidiyena hi'alama'i'ita, na hitowotowolo wahiyala.

Na ebe yaiyadiwo dova hiya, tayogaedi tauyaliyaya wuwuna vitaiwone aidiyena hitowolo wahiyala'o. Na teina hinage ehebo aba'ita Yobi yana alama'i'ita vehabana. Bada amhanapuiya'o ebeha Yobi yana miya vitai yana aba'ovi ainai ana hagu ilobai yada Bada ainaena, wuwuna iya yada Bada tauvelau na tau'atemuyamuya.

Na tahiguwao, ehebo ginauli mwala'ina havena am'awa'awa tamada Tamada yehanaena, yo bale'u ginaulidi aidiyena, yo bada aiteya ginauli aidiyena ebe yami waloyemidi aidiyai. Na hesi ebe amwalo, ‘Ehe’, ebe yami nuwatuwu dova, na ebe nigele, amwalo, ‘Nigele’. Wuwuna ebe ginauli mwala'idi am'ataidi mata howola abo Yaubada ilauvetalaegomiu.
Ebe yaiya yana miya ivitai, howahowana i'awanoi ta'i Yaubada ainai. Ebe yaiya mayana yaliyaya, waliyena Yaubada ino'owei.
Na hinage ebe teya alimiyai mayana lovala, tauyemidiwo yadi taumugaiwo iyogaedima na hi'awanoi vehabana, na hinage woloi ainai hihiwai yada Bada yehanaena.
Na ebe mayadi yemidi hi'awa'awanoi, Yaubada mata ihagui taulovalane, na i'abiye namwanamwa, na hinage ebe mayana pwanoli Yaubada mata inuwahamui.
Eeta ehebo ehebo yami pwanoliwo alimiyai vehabadi amwalo mahalavaei ta vehabadi am'awa'awanoi ta ebe yami namwanamwa amlobai. Moiha ta'i taudumwaluwo yadi awanoi wahiwahiyalana.
Teina ehebo aba'ita alidai, neta Elaitiya, ibom tomowa ta'i dova ita na i'awa'awanoi nuwana maudoina ainaena ta ebe havena 'wesu italutalu bolimai tonuga matupwana aidiyai, eeta dova imamahalavane.
Na hinage dova i'awa'awanoiuyo ta galewaena 'wesu italuma na ai'ai maudoina hi'ini ili'ilimaniuyone.
Na tahiguwao, ebe ehebo alimiyena teya amwaha namwanamwana ilauvehulu, ami gelune amlauvaiyoiyama amwaha namwanamwana ainai.
Teina amnuwatuwu avivini ebe teya towaho amwaha ipwanoli ta alu'aluwana imwalowoi na towaho teya ilauvai ta ihagui, neta mwalowoi ainaena uhaloiya'o ta yana yababao Yaubada iba'ili vehuludi'o.
